source.auditNote: Independently downloaded and byte-SHA256 checked the immutable source-head GitHub Actions ZIP. Recomputed all four vector SHA256 hashes, matched every original client and SQL observation, 14,880 distinct client and SQL operations, per-operation PostgreSQL UTC COMMIT timestamps and 60-bin per-second histograms, 28/28 independent SQL Oracle Gates, exact two postings and one outbox per committed transfer, 50/1000 hot eligibility with 80% source intents and matched direct/Orleans input and final state hashes.

negativeOriginal.finding: C01 original grain-placement precondition failed: all 16 sampled grains on secondary despite two reachable silo gateways. Subsequent C01 pass does not establish its cause and must not erase the original negative run.

interpretation.es: En cuatro ensayos de 62 segundos, con 60 segundos de medición, la base PostgreSQL confirmó 14.880 transferencias persistidas, 29.760 asientos y 14.880 eventos outbox, con 28/28 oráculos SQL correctos. Las tasas reales medidas a partir de timestamps de COMMIT de PostgreSQL fueron 40,0 y 80,0 COMMIT/s, tanto para la ruta directa como para Orleans. A 40/s hubo 40 COMMIT cada segundo; a 80/s las ventanas de un segundo oscilaron entre 79 y 81 COMMIT. No hubo solicitudes perdidas ni respuestas ambiguas. Es una exploración de dos puntos de carga, con una sola repetición en un host físico; NO demuestra saturación, p99 de producción, ventaja de rendimiento de Orleans ni equivalencia MIPS de mainframe. La regresión C01 que falló inicialmente queda registrada en el issue #44.
interpretation.en: Across four 62-second trials with sixty measured seconds, PostgreSQL durably committed 14,880 transfers with 29,760 postings, 14,880 outbox entries and 28/28 passing independent SQL Oracle Gates. Real server-recorded COMMIT rates were 40.0 and 80.0 per second for both direct and Orleans routes. At 40/s there were exactly 40 COMMIT timestamps per one-second bucket; at 80/s, buckets ranged from 79 to 81. No offered intents were missed and no ambiguous outcomes occurred. This is a two-point exploratory load result with one repetition on one physical host; it does NOT establish saturation, production p99, Orleans speed superiority or mainframe MIPS equivalence. The initial negative C01 placement regression remains tracked under issue #44.

limits: One physical Ubuntu runner, four Podman namespaces, one 5%-hot source profile with 80% hot-intent concentration, one repeated run per rate and route, only 60 measurement seconds for offered rates 40 and 80/s. No 3+ independently hosted cohorts, 160+ offered-rate sweep to saturation, physical HA, production p99 SLA, dated cloud/on-prem TCO, hardware mainframe reference workload or MIPS equivalence. SQL pg_stat_database counters contain non-business transactions. ACK-only p99 values are descriptive and cannot rank routes due to sequential order and single-run confounding. E2 remains partially_verified, B05 issue #25 OPEN, C01 placement issue #44 OPEN, release v2026.10.29 unchanged.
